§10.2 Repeated and Unlabelled Fields

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

forms-repeated-and-unlabelled-fields · forms

✅ Normative

Field groups that repeat without a printed heading MUST be kept as anonymous groups in printed order, separated by a blank line in the Markdown. The output MUST NOT invent a heading, label or positional id — no Vehicle 1, no Child 2 — for a group or field the page does not name.

Repeating unlabelled record blocks

Insurance-application premises, vehicle and applicant blocks, and family-court residence blocks repeat the same field set several times and print no heading of their own.

  • Each repetition MUST be rendered as its own group of key-value lines, in printed order.
  • Consecutive groups MUST be separated by one blank line in the Markdown; when a sidecar is produced, each group MUST be its own nested group of items.
  • A heading, number or label that the page does not print MUST NOT be added to tell the groups apart.

Where non-field text goes

Instructions, preambles and fine print MUST be transcribed at their printed reading position, between the fields they accompany — see Fields Outside the Form§10.5.1.

Unlabelled entries with no id

An entry with neither a printed id nor a printed label MUST be rendered as its bare value, or as a bare [blank] when it is empty. A label or positional id MUST NOT be invented for it.

✅ Sample — three identical child blocks

Section 2 prints Child’s Name / Address / City, State / Dates: From … To / Lived with / Relationship to Child three times over, with no heading on any of the three blocks. Each block is an anonymous group, read row by row; the blocks are separated by blank lines.
